summary: Nexstar Media Group filed an 8-K reporting its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.86 per share, payable May 29, 2026 to holders of record May 15, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. It contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return event beyond ordinary course, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The dividend is consistent with the company's stated intent to pay regular quarterly dividends subject to board discretion. No special situation event is present.
